label: Complete-decision fork, by Mathlib order theory
description: A placed diagnostic for 0050b6ed. It certifies #1953's complete-decision fork in Lean with Mathlib's Maximal rather than IsGreatest: a policy that necessarily chooses an undominated complete decision, when some creation strictly surpasses omission, never chooses omission, while each particular creation can still be avoided (control with two incomparable creations); with a strictly improvable creation set and some creation surpassing omission there is no undominated decision. Reading 'never chooses omission' as the giving-level NecessarilyGivesSomeAt of the omission table is an OPEN cross-carrier bridge. The theorem is neutral between personal and impersonal choosers.
